detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Dodge | Plymouth | Chrysler Remastered includes 8 licensed cars from 3 manufacturers!
Dodge:
  • 1968 Dodge Charger
  • 1970 Dodge Challenger R/T
  • 2015 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat
  • 2015 Dodge SRT Viper GTS
Plymouth:
  • 1970 Plymouth Roadrunner
  • 1971 Plymouth HEMI Cuda
Chrysler:
  • 1978 Chrysler Cordoba
  • 2008 Chrysler 300C SRT8

Experience true American power with 6 engines included in this 3in1 DLC:
  • Chrysler V8 6.2 Hellcat
  • Chrysler V10 Viper
  • Chrysler V8 Hemi 426
  • Chrysler V8 Hemi 426 (Hemi shaker)
  • Chrysler V8 LA 360
  • Chrysler V8 Hemi 6.1
